verdict.rationale: Orb documents user-configurable, event-driven automations within billing: usage and credit-balance threshold alerts created via API, automatic top-ups when credits are depleted, and real-time webhooks fired when certain events take place. These are fixed automation types, not a general rule engine where users define arbitrary condition-to-action rules. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/workflow builder with custom conditions and actions, documentation of which actions alerts can trigger beyond notification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
